reference: Same positive reference in every convention, B=sqrt(10*ensemble signal power); ensemble RSR=10 dB, individual realized RSR logged.
noise_and_reference: Signal power excludes B. Complex noise has independent real/imaginary variance sigma2/2.

matching_rule.scope: Both GS100 and EM100 on all five Fig3 points and six Fig4 points; duplicated P20/SNR5 counts as two distinct published figure readings. Criteria fixed before generating audit data.

selection: Rank conventions using validation draws only. Confirmation draws never choose or modify a convention.
stop_rule: Stop before neural training if classical curves clearly reject a common +15.05 dB shift and an equivalent-to-existing convention remains closest; existing full supervised training already tested that normalization. Also do not retrain if no convention matches. Unresolved network-specific normalization and training causes remain inconclusive.
oracle_caveat: LS and true-steering-subspace projection are estimator references, not universal Bayesian lower bounds or ceilings on all learned spatial priors.
immutable_files: All earlier study files, checkpoints and results are read-only. New outputs only in this audit directory.
